item.title: Laya 0.4.2 and VegaML: a Decision Model That Rolls a Ball Downhill, on a 16 GB MacBook
item.description: Laya shipped eight releases and nothing moved for routing. Its author also shipped VegaML, a decision model that answers by letting a particle settle in a valley. Zero-shot it isn’t ready for my router, but it can learn from 40 labels in a minute, which none of the other models can do.
